boundary: quiescent explicit lifecycle operation outside tick execution
required: SelfModel exists and primary body is bound
adapter body/profile/generation agrees with Embodiment occupancy
target BodyProfile resolves and its definition hash is available
no pending Embodiment actuation or delay
no PREPARED habitat execution journal row
no Habitat HeldByLocation references the old body instance
failure_semantics: Any failed condition raises before event, snapshot, or live owner mutation.
held_object_policy: Reject. Placement/transfer is a separate authorized operation; replacement never transfers possession.
unknown_habitat_policy: If Habitat state cannot be reconstructed soundly, reject rather than assume no held object.
